# Bäckerei, Konditorei und Catering in Basel

Herzlich willkommen bei der Bäckerei Bumann GmbH in Basel. In unserem Familienbetrieb in der zweiten Generation werden die Backwaren noch nach altbewährter handwerklicher Tradition mit viel Liebe und Sorgfalt gebacken. Neben der Frische und Qualität liegt uns der regionale Bezug der Rohstoffe am Herzen.

Besonders unsere Spezialitäten wie der Butterzopf, der Russenzopf und die Basler Läckerli sind in unserem Quartier sehr beliebt. Stammkunden schätzen unsere Qualität, ehrliche gebackene Ware und das faire Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.

Wir freuen uns darauf, auch Sie bald in unserer Backstube und Konditorei begrüssen zu dürfen.

firstPass: CSS contrast: .btn: var(--color-on-accent) on var(--color-accent) is 1.02:1, needs 4.5:1
report.brief:
**Signature idea:** A round CSS "bakery stamp" (double ring, text "Bäckerei Bumann · Basel" on a circular path via rotated spans, at -8deg). It acts as the wax seal of the page. It overlaps the hero print's corner, then reappears smaller as the footer seal. Each photo print is "taped" with a translucent CSS strip (mix-blend-mode: multiply).

**Hero:** The headline "Bäckerei, Konditorei und Catering in Basel" is huge, left-aligned across 7 columns. Image #2 sits on the right as a white-bordered print at 2deg, bleeding past the top. The stamp overlaps its lower-left edge. Include one filled CTA, nothing else.

**Sections:**
1. Offer: three sticker labels ("Bäckerei", "Konditorei", "Catering"), each pinned to a print (#5, #7, #6) in a staggered, right-heavy row with different rotations.
2. "Über unsere Backstube": text on the left at 60ch, with a stacked pile of #3 and #4 overlapping on the right.
3. Visit: hours, address and phone as plain text. Image #8 sits small at -3deg on the left.

**Type:** Syne 800 headline at 88px, lowercase-insensitive sentence case. Epilogue 400/500 body at 17px, line-height 1.55. Expressive detail: the ampersand-free headline breaks before "in Basel".

**Images:** 12px white borders and a hard 2px offset shadow. Apply sepia(0.08) saturate(1.1). Use tight crops on the pastry texture. Image #1 goes in the footer.

**Detail:** Sticker labels have one peeled corner made from a CSS triangle.

**Avoid:** cream-plus-terracotta, centred stacks, soft blurred shadows.
slop: Three equal columns of shadowed cards: the most common AI layout. Use an asymmetric or list-based layout instead.
report.critique: 1. **.btn contrast (1.02:1).** Change `background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary);` so it uses the same verified pair as `.stamp`. Then accent appears only on the tape (`.print::before`), which stays inside the "accent at most twice" rule. Also remove the "→" from "Jetzt anrufen →", since it is glyph decoration. 2. **Offer reads as three equal cards.** The 0.5fr spacer plus three 1fr columns is still the flagged pattern. Change `.offer__row` to `grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0,1fr))` and size the items unequally: - `.offer__item:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 2 / 5; margin-top: 96px }` - `:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 6 / 10; margin-top: 0 }` - `:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 10 / 13; margin-top: 160px }` Remove `max-width: 360px`. Remove `box-shadow: var(--shadow-card)` from `.sticker`, because it is likely soft and blurred. Use `box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--color-text)` to match the hard print shadow. 3. **Headline breaks the brief.** The brief's headline is "Bäckerei, Konditorei und Catering in Basel". The page uses "Traditionsreiche Bäckerei", which is a deviation. Restore it as `Bäckerei, Konditorei und Catering in Basel`. - **Size:** set `.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(44px, 9vw, 88px) }` on desktop instead of the 5.6vw calc. That gives 88px, which is at least 4× the 17px body. - **Underline:** remove `text-decoration` from `.place`, because colour plus underline is double emphasis. - **390px overflow:** at 9vw, "Konditorei" is about 35px wide and fits. "Bäckerei, Konditorei und Catering" will wrap, and that is acceptable. Drop `hyphens: auto` so you don't get "Kondi-torei". 4. **Hero print is too small and doesn't bleed.** At `max-width: 346px` it reads as a thumbnail. Change `.hero__photo { max-width: none; margin-top: -152px }` so it bleeds past the hero top and under the header border. Give the header `position: relative; z-index: 2`, or let the print overlap it intentionally. - **Image source:** you load `-315w.jpg` and upscale it. Use the `-1920w` variant. - **Crop:** set `.hero__photo .print img { aspect-ratio: 4/5; object-position: 40% 60% }` for a tight pastry crop. - **Stamp:** `left: -56px` overflows the column on mobile. Keep the mobile value at `left: -8px`. It is currently correct, so don't regress it. 5. **Tape is identical on every print.** Vary it per tilt with `.print::before { transform: rotate(var(--tape, -4deg)); left: var(--tape-x, 50%) }`. Then set `--tape: 6deg; --tape-x: 30%` on `.pile .print:last-child`, and `--tape-x: 70%` on the offer item 2 print. Also, `border: 1px solid` plus `border-radius` on `.print` softens the photo-print feel. Set `border-radius: 0` on `.print` and keep the radius token for controls only. 6. **Invented copy (remove):** - Offer intro: "Knuspriges vom Morgen, Süsses für zwischendurch. Und für Ihren Anlass bringen wir gern etwas mit." - About: "So einfach ist das." - Visit intro: "Unter der Woche ab früh am Morgen für Sie da." - Figcaption: "Zitronenkuchen. Ein Stück Sonne, auch an grauen Tagen." - Stamp core "Basel": the brief text is the ring only. Use the ring text alone or leave the core empty. The about copy repeats the hero sub nearly verbatim. Cut one of the two. 7. **Weak contrast to check.** `.facts .closed`, `.section-head p` and `.footer__text p` use `--color-text-muted` on `--color-surface`/`--color-bg`. Verify they reach 4.5:1 at 15px (`--text-sm`), or switch them to `--color-text`. The `.sticker::after` peel fills with `--color-surface`, but the sticker sits on a surface-coloured section, so the peel is invisible. Use `border-color: transparent var(--color-text-muted) var(--color-bg) transparent` so the fold reads. 8. **390px overflow and the footer seal.** - `.stamp__ring span` uses a fixed 13.85deg step for 26 glyphs, which is 360°. That is correct, but the footer override `font-size: 0.6em` at `--text-sm` becomes illegible at about 8px. Set the minimum to 10px. - The email `info@baeckerei-bumann.ch` in `.facts` needs `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on mobile. - The footer is a flex row of logo, stamp and text. Give the stamp the brief's role by overlapping the logo box: `.site-footer .stamp { margin-left: -48px; margin-top: -40px }`.
